Class ServerConfig

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.ServerConfig
public final class ServerConfig extends Object
Immutable server policy, command edits, and normalized admission lookups.

    • DEFAULT_DISABLE_ITEMS

      public static final List<String> DEFAULT_DISABLE_ITEMS
      Items barred by default. Each crashes the client when its plain ItemStack is drawn, as a gallery creates it and as extracting it drops or hands it to the player:
      • evilcraft:broom_part (EvilCraft 1.2.62): its model throws UnsupportedOperationException.
